highYield.fact: Cardiac AP: ventricular resting -90 mV (Phase 0 INa, Phase 2 ICa,L plateau prevents tetanus) vs SA node -60 mV (Phase 4 If, Phase 0 ICa,L only); check QTc/K+/Mg2+ before QT-prolonging drugs
PV loops: preload widens right; afterload taller/narrower (↑LVESV); contractility steepens ESPVR; S4 never heard in AF; stop fluids on flat Starling limb
ARDS lung-protective ventilation: VT 6 mL/kg predicted body weight (never actual), Pplat <=30 cmH2O, driving pressure <15 cmH2O; high Ppeak + normal Pplat = airway resistance

Gas exchange: true R→L shunt does NOT correct on 100% FiO2; CO poisoning gives false normal SpO2 (240x affinity, left shift); MetHb fixed ~85% SpO2 → methylene blue (avoid in G6PD); chronic CO2 retainers target SpO2 88-92%
Renal arterioles & nephron: NSAIDs constrict afferent (↓GFR), ACEi/ARB dilate efferent (↓GFR, ↓FF); triple whammy = NSAID + ACEi/ARB + diuretic; loops lose Ca2+, thiazides retain Ca2+
Never correct chronic hyponatraemia (>48 h) >8 mEq/L per 24 h (ODS risk)

Shock haemodynamics table (hypovolaemic, cardiogenic, obstructive, distributive); neurogenic shock (>T6) = hypotension + bradycardia; anaphylaxis = immediate IM epinephrine 0.3-0.5 mg; early Hb can be normal in acute bleeding
